title: What Installment 1 Carries Under Each Payment Plan
content:
# Payment plan note — what installment 1 carries

**Rule.** What installment 1 of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category carries depends on how the stay is paid:

- on a stay of 28 nights or more paid in monthly installments, installment 1 carries the first block of nights per installment of the stay's policy (every night of the stay where it has fewer) at the stay's night price, the nightly subtotal divided by the stay's nights rounded half up to the cent, together with the cleaning, pet and extra-guest fees in full;
- on a pay-part-now stay, installment 1 carries the deposit percentage of the stay's policy of the nightly subtotal and of those fees;
- on any other stay it carries the whole nightly subtotal and the fees.

The payment plan, nights, nightly subtotal and fees are those recorded on the stay.

## Policy figures

| Policy | Nights per monthly installment | Pay-part-now deposit |
|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 50.00% |
| Moderate | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 50.00% |
| Limited | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 50.00% |
| Firm | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 50.00% |
| Strict | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 0.00% (not offered) |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 0.00% (not offered) |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0 (monthly installments not used) | 0.00% (not offered) |
| Long-Term | 30 | 0.00% (not offered) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical stays)

| Stay | Working | Installment 1 carries |
|---|---|---|
| 60 nights, Long-Term, monthly; nightly subtotal 7,200.00; cleaning 200.00; pet 50.00 | night price 120.00; 30 nights, 3,600.00, plus fees 250.00 | 3,850.00 |
| 29 nights, Long-Term, monthly; nightly subtotal 2,900.00; cleaning 150.00 | 29 nights at 100.00, plus 150.00 | 3,050.00 |
| 8 nights, Firm, pay-part-now; nightly subtotal 1,000.00; fees 150.00 | 50.00% of 1,150.00 | 575.00 |
| 8 nights, Strict, paid in full; nightly subtotal 1,000.00; fees 150.00 | whole | 1,150.00 |
